verdict.rationale: Customer.io documents that users can set up recurring tasks the AI agent runs automatically on a schedule, such as deliverability reports, segment audits and broadcast recaps (docs-33). The pricing page lists "Daily Routines (scheduled tasks)" (docs-57). Broadcasts can also be queued for a specified time (docs-13), but that is one-time scheduling rather than recurrence. Missing for 10: documented cadence and configuration options beyond daily, explicit recurring scheduling of automations/workflows themselves (automations are documented as event- or segment-triggered), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
